evidence.title: Newey gives initial verdict on Aston Martin’s update package
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Adrian Newey has explained how “getting to a point of respectability” is the “immediate goal” for Aston Martin with the introduction of their upgrade package at the Hungarian Grand Prix.

evidence.title: Fernando Alonso gives first verdict on Aston Martin updates after finishing 19th in FP2 at Hungarian GP
evidence.body: [e004:f01] Two-time F1 champion Fernando Alonso issued a positive verdict on his heavily-upgraded AMR26, despite finishing 19th during the second practice session at the Hungarian Grand Prix. [e004:f02] Aston Martin had a mixed Friday at the Hungaroring. [e004:f03] The excitement of the 16 upgrades and almost entirely different AMR26 soon wore off, when Lance Stroll was forced out of FP1 with a suspected broken rear suspension. [e004:f04] The incident meant that Stroll was not even able to head out in FP2 , meaning he did not get the running in the B-spec AMR26 that he would have liked. [e004:f05] Article continues under video Alonso, on the other hand, did well to put in a time quick enough for 13th in FP1, before finishing 19th in FP2, where he was more focusing on long-run pace. [e004:f06] Design legend Adrian Newey has been working hard on Aston Martin's upgrades ever since it became clear that their first chassis design was below par. [e004:f07] Aston Martin have struggled with performance and reliability issues in 2026, and have so far only scored one point from the opening 10 grand prix weekends of the season. [e004:f08] But now, they are hoping to be challenging more closely with the midfield teams, before building towards a future challenge for podiums and race victories in 2027 or 2028. [e004:f09] "Yeah, it felt good," Alonso told media after FP2. [e004:f10] "I think in general we had what we expected in terms of numbers and correlation, which is obviously very encouraging for the future as well, for next year's car and the future upgrades this year. [e004:f11] "So yeah, still a long way to go for us, obviously starting so far behind, but this is the first step, hopefully, of good ones coming." These upgrades are said to have a big bearing on whether or not Alonso will sign a new contract in the sport, although the 44-year-old played down that talk ahead of the Hungarian GP weekend. [e004:f12] Alonso is due to be out of contract at the end of this season , and still needs to make a final decision as to whether he will continue on in the sport or not in 2027. [e004:f13] Remarkably, the Spaniard made his F1 debut back in 2001, and has raced in the most amount of grands prix in F1 history. [e004:f14] Alonso is also a two-time world champion, with those two championships won in 2005 and 2006, but he has not won a grand prix since the 2013 Spanish Grand Prix.

evidence.title: AirAsia launches snap sale to KL after Bahrain Grand Prix relocates to Malaysia
evidence.body: [e002:f01] The relocated F1 event, which is subject to final agreements and official sign-off, including the approval of the World Motor Sport Council, will become the Formula 1 Gulf Air Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia at the Sepang International Circuit from October 2-4, between the Azerbaijan and Singapore Grands Prix. [e002:f02] It follows ongoing conflict in the Middle East, which raised serious safety and logistical concerns for F1 teams and support crew. [e002:f03] An Air Asia Snap Sale flyer offering flights to KL. [e002:f04] AirAsia has launched a Snap Sale to Kuala Lumpur to coincide with the switch, offering one-way flight-only fares and flight-and-hotel packages from three Australian cities. [e002:f05] From Perth, flight-only fares start from $187 one-way, with flight and hotel packages, including a six-day, five-night stay, from $379 per guest; travel is valid from 1 October, 2026 to 30 June, 2027. [e002:f06] From Melbourne, flight-only fares start from $384 one-way and packages from $762 per guest, with travel valid from 20 July, 2026 to 30 June, 2027. [e002:f07] From Sydney, flight-only fares start from $313 one-way and packages from $672 per guest, over the same travel window as Melbourne. [e002:f08] The sale also includes discounts of up to 35 per cent on checked baggage from Perth, up to 50 per cent from Melbourne, and up to 40 per cent from Sydney. [e002:f09] Fares must be booked by 2 August, 2026, are valid for selected travel dates only, and apply during initial flight bookings made via the AirAsia MOVE platform, subject to availability, for travel until 31 March, 2027. [e002:f10] The new agreement, reached between Formula 1, the FIA, the Government of Bahrain, and the Government of Malaysia, allows Formula 1 to preserve a Grand Prix that would otherwise not have happened. [e002:f11] Sepang – which made its debut as an F1 venue in 1999 – is one of Formula 1’s most iconic and challenging circuits, known for its passionate fans, exciting racing and unpredictable weather. [e002:f12] Information regarding the release of tickets for the event will be announced soon. [e002:f13] “We are delighted to confirm that Malaysia will host the Bahrain Grand Prix in 2026,” President and CEO of Formula 1, Stefano Domenicali, said. [e002:f14] “I would like to express our sincere thanks to His Majesty King Hamad bin Isa Al Khalifa, King of Bahrain, His Royal Highness Prince Salman bin Hamad Al Khalifa and His Majesty Sultan Ibrahim, King of Malaysia, as well as their respective governments for making this extraordinary outcome possible through their vision, commitment, and decisive action. [e002:f15] “Of course, I would also like to thank FIA President Mohammed Ben Sulayem for his partnership and collaboration throughout the process. [e002:f16] Malaysia is an incredible country, and Sepang holds a special place in Formula 1 history.

evidence.title: Formula 1 Returns to Sepang as Malaysia Agrees to Host Bahrain Grand Prix
evidence.body: [e005:f01] "It reflects the enduring friendship, mutual trust and close partnership between Malaysia and the Kingdom of Bahrain." The announcement is welcome news for Formula 1 fans, many of whom have long called for Sepang's return. [e005:f02] 2-4 as part of a unique agreement designed to preserve the championship calendar. [e005:f03] The event, officially titled the Formula 1 Gulf Air Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia, will be held between the Azerbaijan and Singapore Grands Prix and marks Formula 1's first visit to Sepang since the 2017 season. [e005:f04] The unprecedented arrangement was reached among Formula 1, the FIA, the governments of Bahrain and Malaysia, and both circuits. [e005:f05] The agreement allows Bahrain to maintain its place on the 2026 schedule while bringing Formula 1 back to one of the sport's most popular venues. [e005:f06] "This collaboration is more than the staging of a world-class sporting event," Malaysian Prime Minister Dato' Seri Anwar Ibrahim said. [e005:f07] Known for its challenging layout, intense heat, tropical weather and frequent strategic unpredictability, the circuit hosted Formula 1 races from 1999 through 2017 and produced many memorable moments during the modern era. [e005:f08] Formula 1 President and CEO Stefano Domenicali praised the partnership that made the race possible. [e005:f09] "We are delighted to confirm that Malaysia will host the Bahrain Grand Prix in 2026," Domenicali said. [e005:f10] They will continue to enjoy a full and exciting Formula 1 calendar, while also seeing the sport return to a great venue." The event also highlights Bahrain's longstanding relationship with Formula 1. [e005:f11] Bahrain hosted the Middle East's first Formula 1 race in 2004 and has become one of the championship's cornerstone events over the past two decades. [e005:f12] Bahrain Crown Prince and Prime Minister Prince Salman bin Hamad Al Khalifa called the arrangement a reflection of Bahrain's commitment to the sport. [e005:f13] "This will be a wonderful experience for fans around the world and reflects Bahrain's enduring commitment to, and passion for, the sport," he said. [e005:f14] FIA President Mohammed Ben Sulayem added that the agreement demonstrates international cooperation across motorsport and ensures the championship maintains a full schedule despite logistical and regional challenges. [e005:f15] The remainder of the 2026 Formula 1 calendar remains unchanged. [e005:f16] Ticket information for the race weekend is expected to be announced in the coming months, pending final approvals and World Motor Sport Council confirmation.

evidence.title: ヒュンダイとFIAが地域ラリーの促進で提携
evidence.body: [e007:f01] ©ヒュンダイメディア FIAはヒュンダイ・モータースポーツと協力して、今後開催されるi20 Rally2でのWRCラウンドの賞金を獲得して、XNUMXつの主要地域にわたってラリーを宣伝している。 [e007:f02] 名前の下に FIA ラリー チャンピオンズ ワールド ツアー 、国際連盟と連携して ヒュンダイ モータースポーツは、地域レベルのモータースポーツを促進したいと考えています。 [e007:f03] ラリー アフリカ選手権、アジアパシフィック選手権、CODASUR選手権、中東選手権、NACAMラリー選手権のXNUMXつの主要グループに分かれています。 [e007:f04] これらの異なる2021年シリーズの勝者は、報酬として、開発が進められている将来のヒュンダイi2022ラリー20のハンドルを握って、2年の世界ラリー選手権のラウンドを受け取ることができる。 [e007:f05] FIAはさらに、このプログラムが2022年間にわたって実施されることを発表した。 [e007:f06] 2023年とXNUMX年の優勝クルーにも賞の資格があり、イベントに参加することになる。 [e007:f07] WRC 2023年と2024年のシーズン中に。 [e007:f08] 「ヒュンダイ・モータースポーツと提携して開発されたこの取り組みを発表できることを非常にうれしく誇りに思います。 [e007:f09] これはFIA地域ラリー選手権を強化し、全大陸の競技者にとってより魅力的なものにするのに役立ちます。 [e007:f10] FIAラリーボスのイブ・マットンを指す。 [e007:f11] さらに、欧州以外の国籍の競技者がラリーピラミッドの頂点に登るルートを作り出すことで、世界ラリー選手権にさらなる多様性がもたらされ、特に地域のスター選手が世界ラリー選手権の主力イベントに参加するおかげで、ポジティブなメディア報道が生まれるだろう。 [e007:f12] さらに、翌年の i20 Rally2 で世界レベルに到達するチャンスも得られます。 [e007:f13] » オンラインでの WRC シミュレーションと実車の両方で若い才能を発掘することを目的としたラリー スターに続く、FIA の功績が認められる新しい取り組みです。 [e007:f14] この記事にコメントする 編集チームは提案する ラリー 24/07/2026 19:00 8月上旬にスコットランドで開催されるグランピアン・フォレスト・ラリーには、非常に豪華な出場選手たちが集結する予定です。 [e007:f15] 平等に読む ラリー 27/07/2026 09:54 ジュリアン・イングラシアは今週末フィンランドでセバスチャン・オジエとともに復帰する CFR 27/07/2026 08:36 レハネ・ガニーがツール・オート・ド・ラ・レユニオンでキャリア3勝目を挙げる ERC 26/07/2026 17:56 ERC – ラリー・ポーランド：テーム・スニネンが優勝し、チャンピオンシップのリードをさらに広げる 購読者限定 今週の雑誌 今週号と過去の号をデジタル版で、またはご自宅でご覧ください！ [e007:f16] Acheter S'abonner。

evidence.title: Perché Lewis Hamilton è stato penalizzato: le cause dell’investigazione e le posizioni perse
evidence.body: [e001:f01] [Image 3](https:// Pubblicato 1 giorno fa il 25 Luglio 2026 ! [e001:f02] text=Perch%C3%A9%20Lewis%20Hamilton%20%C3%A8%20stato%20penalizzato:%20le%20cause%20dell%E2%80%99investigazione%20e%20le%20posizioni%20perse%20https:// **AGGIORNAMENTO ORE 18.45. [e001:f03] Lewis Hamilton è stato penalizzato di tre posizioni** per avere ostacolato Oscar Piastri. [e001:f04] Il pilota della Ferrari **scivola dalla seconda alla quinta posizione e dunque dovrà partire in terza fila.** — **Lewis Hamilton** rischia di vedere sfumare la prima fila conquistata nelle **qualifiche del Gran Premio d’Ungheria**. [e001:f05] Al termine della sessione ufficiale, infatti, il sette volte campione del mondo è stato convocato dai commissari FIA per **un presunto episodio di impeding** ai danni di **Oscar Piastri**, un’infrazione che, qualora venisse confermata, potrebbe costargli una penalità in griglia. **L’episodio si è verificato nel corso del Q3**, la fase decisiva delle qualifiche. [e001:f06] Alla prima curva dell’Hungaroring, Hamilton stava procedendo a velocità ridotta mentre si trovava sulla traiettoria ideale proprio nel momento in cui Piastri era impegnato in un giro lanciato. [e001:f07] Il pilota della McLaren è stato così costretto a rallentare e ad alzare il piede dall’acceleratore per evitare la Ferrari, compromettendo di fatto il tentativo cronometrato. [e001:f08] Si tratta di una situazione che rientra nella casistica dell’impeding citato, ovvero **l’ostruzione di un altro concorrente durante una sessione di qualifica**. [e001:f09] Il regolamento sportivo della FIA vieta infatti di ostacolare ingiustificatamente un pilota impegnato in un giro veloce, anche quando l’episodio non sia frutto di un comportamento intenzionale. [e001:f10] Ora la decisione passa ai commissari sportivi, che analizzeranno le immagini televisive, i dati di telemetria e le comunicazioni radio tra Hamilton e il muretto Ferrari prima di emettere il verdetto. [e001:f11] In casi analoghi, **la sanzione più frequentemente applicata è una penalità di tre posizioni sulla griglia di partenza**. [e001:f12] Hamilton aveva infatti concluso le qualifiche al secondo posto, mancando la pole position per appena 12 millesimi rispetto al tempo fatto segnare da **Lando Norris**. [e001:f13] Un’eventuale retrocessione di tre posizioni **lo farebbe scivolare fino alla quinta casella**, favorendo direttamente il compagno di squadra**Charles Leclerc**, che salirebbe in prima fila accanto al poleman. [Aggiungi OA Sport come Fonte preferita su Google](https:// **Quella di Lewis non è però l’unica posizione al vaglio della direzione gara**. [e001:f14] Anche **Kimi Antonelli** è finito sotto investigazione per un presunto mancato rispetto del regime di bandiere gialle, esposte dopo il testacoda di **Max Verstappen**. evidence.title: Lewis Hamilton under threat as FIA launches Hungarian GP investigation
evidence.body: [e002:f01] FIA launches Lewis Hamilton investigation over Oscar Piastri incident FIA launches Lewis Hamilton investigation over Oscar Piastri incident FIA launches Lewis Hamilton investigation over Oscar Piastri incident Oliver Harden 25 Jul 2026 4:54 PM The FIA has launched a stewards' investigation Ferrari driver Lewis Hamilton is under investigation by the FIA stewards after impeding Oscar Piastri’s McLaren in qualifying at the Hungarian Grand Prix. [e002:f02] Hamilton was forced to settle for second place in qualifying in Budapest as Lando Norris, the McLaren driver and reigning world champion, secured his first pole position of the F1 2026 season. [e002:f03] Lewis Hamilton under investigation by FIA stewards after Oscar Piastri incident The FIA has confirmed a penalty for Lewis Hamilton since this article was published The Ferrari driver was involved in an impeding incident with Norris’s teammate Piastri in the closing moments of the session. [e002:f04] Piastri encountered a slow moving Hamilton at Turn 1 at the start of his final Q3 lap. [e002:f05] The Australian went on to qualify fifth, 0.477 seconds slower than teammate Norris. [e002:f06] The FIA stewards have launched an investigation into the incident with Hamilton and Piastri summoned. [e002:f07] Both drivers, along with team representatives of Ferrari and McLaren, are required to visit the stewards at 1800 local time in Budapest. [e002:f08] Speaking in the post-qualifying press conference, Hamilton revealed that he was informed too late that Piastri was approaching. [e002:f09] “Everyone came out behind me, I was the first out, so I thought everyone had finished their lap. [e002:f10] “Crazy because it’d been [a] clean [session] and obviously it wasn’t intentional.” Lewis Hamilton vs Charles Leclerc: Ferrari head-to-head stats for F1 2026 season F1 2026: Head-to-head qualifying records between teammates F1 2026: Head-to-head race statistics between teammates The investigation against Hamilton comes after the seven-time world champion questioned Ferrari’s decision to go out first for the final Q3 runs. evidence.title: FIA announce Lewis Hamilton penalty at Hungarian Grand Prix
evidence.body: [e003:f01] Seven-time F1 champion Lewis Hamilton has been handed an FIA penalty after an incident during Hungarian Grand Prix qualifying. [e003:f02] Hamilton is hoping top claim a ninth Hungarian GP victory this weekend, and looked to have a very good chance of doing just that after qualifying up in second behind Lando Norris. [e003:f03] But immediately after the session, Hamilton was noted for an alleged impeding offence on Norris' McLaren team-mate Oscar Piastri, and was called to see the stewards. [e003:f04] Article continues under video Now, it's been revealed that Hamilton has been given a three-place grid drop for the race on Sunday, for 'unnecessarily impeding' Piastri. [e003:f05] It means that Hamilton will start the Hungarian Grand Prix from fifth, a huge blow to his chances of victory given the nature of the Hungaroring and the difficulties that drivers have overtaking around it. [e003:f06] The 41-year-old though was given a boost when shortly after his title rival Kimi Antonelli was also hit with a three-place grid penalty . [e003:f07] Hamilton was finishing a hot lap during Q3 when he slowed down heading into turn one, but McLaren 's Piastri was fast approaching having just started his own flying lap. [e003:f08] Ferrari boss Fred Vasseur said after the session that Ferrari had not given Hamilton enough warning of Piastri's arrival into turn one, and the official verdict from the FIA seemed to confirm this too. [e003:f09] "At the approach to turn one, car 44 was travelling at a significantly reduced speed on the racing line while car 81 was approaching on a push lap," FIA race stewards said. [e003:f10] "The driver of car 44 explained that he had just completed a fast lap and did not receive the team's radio message regarding the approaching car 81 until the latter was already in close proximity. [e003:f11] He further stated that, due to the positioning of his car on the track, car 81 was not visible in his mirrors. [e003:f12] Having examined the available evidence, the Stewards determined that car 44 unnecessarily impeded car 81 during qualifying." Hamilton's penalty will be made even more frustrating by the fact that he will now start the race behind his championship rival Kimi Antonelli. [e003:f13] Antonelli is 45 points ahead of Hamilton in the drivers' championship , and will now start up in third, behind Norris and Hamilton's team-mate Charles Leclerc. [e003:f14] McLaren star Piastri suggested after qualifying that Hamilton was the reason why he was not able to challenge his team-mate Norris for the pole position. [e003:f15] "It was just Lewis not looking in his mirrors," Piastri told Sky Sports F1. [e003:f16] "A shame because it meant I didn't get a lap in either way.

evidence.title: Adrian Newey addresses Stroll red flag as Honda launches investigation
evidence.body: [e004:f01] Adrian Newey addresses Stroll setback amid Honda investigation Jamie Woodhouse 24 Jul 2026 7:11 PM Adrian Newey observing in the Aston Martin garage Adrian Newey suggested that Lance Stroll ’s suspected rear suspension failure in Hungary was not related to the Aston Martin AMR26 upgrade package. [e004:f02] Newey therefore described it as a “very unexpected” failure as Aston Martin begins its opening phase of developing the AMR26. [e004:f03] Newey also confirmed that Honda is investigating the cause of vibrations, which were reported by Fernando Alonso, and could be seen on the data. [e004:f04] In terms of pace, there were encouraging signs for Aston Martin. [e004:f05] It was a more frustrating Friday on Lance Stroll’s side of the garage. [e004:f06] Stroll triggered the red flags when he spun out of FP1. [e004:f07] Stroll did not appear in FP2, as extensive work continued on his car. [e004:f08] Adrian Newey, Aston Martin team principal and design chief, addressed the situation in Friday’s team leaders’ press conference. [e004:f09] The area of failure in question was not a part of Aston Martin’s 16-piece upgrade, Newey confirmed. [e004:f10] “Everybody is feverishly trying to understand exactly what went wrong and what happened as we speak, and it’s only once we have an understanding that we can comment on what we do next,” Newey told and others. evidence.title: Mercedes F1 boss Toto Wolff launches extraordinary 'Teletubbies' rant at rival teams
evidence.body: [e005:f01] Backmarkers getting in the way of the frontrunners was a theme of the race at the Hungaroring, with Williams' Carlos Sainz even making contact with McLaren's Oscar Piastri when he was chasing after a race win. [e005:f02] Traffic got in the way of Mercedes' championship leader Kimi Antonelli towards the end of the race too, almost allowing Lewis Hamilton to get by him for third. [e005:f03] Article continues under video It was revealed after the race that there was a fault with the blue flag system which is used by FIA race stewards to tell backmarkers to move out of the way when they are being lapped by faster cars. [e005:f04] When a blue flag is waved or signified via the FIA's light panels, said driver must get out of the way at their earliest convenience, and they will be punished if they fail to do so after being given three warnings. [e005:f05] But the system seemed to be showing even to drivers at the front of the race, with both Lando Norris and Antonelli revealing in the cooldown room that they had been shown blue flags at various points in the race. [e005:f06] Nonetheless, Antonelli's boss Wolff was disappointed with some of the smaller teams' race engineers, slamming them for not telling their drivers when there were faster cars behind. [e005:f07] F1 RESULTS TODAY: Hungarian Grand Prix times and positions Wolff fumes at race engineers Wolff suggested to Sky Sports F1 that some of the race engineers could have been doing a much better job during the Hungarian GP, describing them as 'Teletubbies', while also blasting the backmarkers' refusal to let frontrunners through as 'unacceptable'. [e005:f08] Teletubbies was a British TV programme in the early 2000s aimed at very young children, with four characters known Tinky-Winky, Dipsy, Lala and that resembled toddlers and talked gibberish. [e005:f09] When Antonelli approached a gaggle of cars towards the end of the race, it was four drivers who were scrapping over the last couple of points-paying positions, which potentially led to them not wanting to yield as easily to the faster cars coming through. [e005:f10] "The cars in the back defending is just not acceptable and not good enough from us," Wolff said. [e005:f11] "And you know, then the marshalling system not functioning. [e005:f12] And cars in the back defending from Lewis and Kimi. [e005:f13] "I just find disgraceful from some of the Teletubbies engineers that sit on the pit walls of these teams, not telling the drivers what's happening behind. [e005:f14] "And so, overall, a day I'm just, I'm just not happy about the whole situation.

evidence.title: FIA announce late Lewis Hamilton penalty at Hungarian Grand Prix
evidence.body: [e006:f01] Lewis Hamilton was given a five-second penalty towards the end of the Hungarian Grand Prix, ruining his chances of a podium in the F1 race. [e006:f02] Hamilton had pitted during a virtual safety car period, ditching his old hard tyres and moving onto a set of soft tyres in order to try and chase after Max Verstappen and race leader Lando Norris . [e006:f03] However, when he came out of the pits, he managed to get ahead of Mercedes ' Kimi Antonelli despite being under virtual safety car conditions. [e006:f04] Ferrari immediately told him to give the position back, as to avoid picking up a penalty. [e006:f05] Article continues under video But despite doing this, Hamilton would go on to pick up a penalty anyway, after having been found guilty of speeding in the pit lane by FIA race stewards. [e006:f06] Hamilton, who was running up in fourth at the time that the penalty was handed out, took to team radio to say to his race engineer Carlo Santi: "Handing out penalties like crazy". [e006:f07] Hamilton had previously been given a three-place grid drop after qualifying for an impeding incident involving Oscar Piastri, while he also picked up penalties at the recent Belgian and British Grands Prix. [e006:f08] But despite looking to have a faster car than Antonelli's Mercedes for much of the Hungarian GP weekend, Hamilton actually ended up losing five points to the young Italian as a result of his race performance. [e006:f09] Hamilton's penalty demoted him behind team-mate Charles Leclerc and down into fifth, while Antonelli finished up in third. [e006:f10] It means that the 19-year-old now leads the 41-year-old Hamilton by 50 points heading into the summer break. [e006:f11] Hamilton did, however, extend his lead over George Russell in third in the championship, who finished the Hungarian GP down in seventh after a dismal start. [e006:f12] Lando Norris won the race having claimed pole position over Hamilton by just 12 thousandths of a second during Saturday qualifying.

evidence.title: F1レギュレーション：FIAが発表した変更点
evidence.body: [e007:f01] 問題は確かに安全性だったが、純粋な運転技術も関係しており、電気エネルギーの配分管理の重要性に比べると、運転技術は時に後回しにされがちだった。 [e007:f02] これらの苦情は、様々な関係者から提起された些細な問題（スタート手順、予選で消費されるエネルギー量など）をさらに悪化させ、積み重なり始めていた。 [e007:f03] 中東グランプリの中止という不運に見舞われたものの、FIAは思わぬ幸運を見出した。 [e007:f04] 一連の会議を経て、月曜日にFIA、FOM、チーム、エンジンメーカーの間でビデオ会議が行われ、最終的に決定が下されました。 [e007:f05] 最大許容充電電力は8 MJから7 MJに削減され、スーパークリッピング時間を1周あたり4秒から2秒に短縮することを目指しています。 [e007:f06] なお、日本グランプリの予選前には、充電電力はすでに9 MJから8 MJに削減されていましたが、それでもドライバーがフルスロットルで1周を完走するには不十分でした。 [e007:f07] セキュリティの強化、特に開始時 レースに関しては、鈴鹿でのベアマンのクラッシュにつながった過度な速度差を避けるため、ブーストの最大出力は150kWに制限される。 [e007:f08] 最後に、グリップとパフォーマンスを向上させるため、ウェットコンディション時の中間タイヤウォーマーの温度が上昇しました。 [e007:f09] これらの変更はすべて、世界モータースポーツ評議会の投票を経て、5月1日から3日に開催される選手権第4戦マイアミグランプリから適用されます。 [e007:f10] この記事にコメントする 編集チームは提案する F1 26/07/2026 18:25 フレデリック・ヴァスール監督、ハンガリー戦後総括：「我々はあまりにも多くのミスを犯した」 平等に読む F1 25/07/2026 19:33 イサック・ハジャールはハンガリーグランプリで大胆な走りをするつもりだ。 [e007:f11] F1 26/07/2026 19:19 ハンガリー戦後、ローラン・メキーズ監督は「我々は勝つためだけに契約した」と強い口調で語った。 [e007:f12] F1 26/07/2026 16:44 ハンガリーGP – ノリスが今シーズン初優勝、フェルスタッペンとアントネッリがサプライズ表彰台入り 7コメント A アラン・フェガンヌ (🇱🇺ルクセンブルク) 25/04/26 ジャッキー・イクスはドイツでのインタビューで、私たちのほとんどが考えていることを代弁してくれた。 [e007:f13] [email protected] 😉🧐 A アラン・フェガンヌ (🇱🇺ルクセンブルク) 22/04/26 F1 2026は、少なくともレギュレーションの面では大惨事であるという点では、皆同意するでしょう👎。 [e007:f14] ドライバーがコントロールしなければなりません...😎👀🧐 アラン・フェグエンヌ F1コンペティションズ – ル・マン24時間レース – WEC D ドチェズ 22/04/26 そうそう、F1ドライバーは才能に加えて「コンピュータープログラマー」としての能力も必要になるんだ… C CBP 22/04/26 彼らはこんな馬鹿げたことをやめるべきだ。 [e007:f15] v ヴァンサン・モエ 21/04/26 ル・マンとFIAは高速道路のような直線コースでの人工的な追い越しをなかなか手放そうとしないようだが、これは正しい方向への一歩と言えるだろう。 [e007:f16] Y イヴ・アンリ・ランディエ 21/04/26 リバティ・メディアとFIAのコンビは、様々な関係者の意見に耳を傾けるという現実的な姿勢を示しており、これは既に良い兆候と言えるでしょう。

evidence.body: [e002:f01] LATEST POSTS: Meta Launches Seller App for Facebook Marketplace CISA Warns of Russian Zimbra Zero-Day Espionage Campaign Origin Energy Confirms Customer Data Breach Reviewed By Barry Elad Barry Elad Founder & Senior Journalist • 765 Articles Barry Elad is a seasoned journalist and analyst specializing in finance, technology, AI, and founder of SQ Magazine. [e002:f02] LATEST POSTS: OpenAI Brings ChatGPT Voice to the Desktop App Anthropic Adds Model Choice to Claude Voice Mode For All Users OpenAI Opens ChatGPT Health to All US Users Amid Lawsuit As Featured In SpaceX flew 165 orbital missions in 2025, another annual launch record and roughly 85% of the United States’ total tally for the year, according to tracking of the launch manifest. [e002:f03] Below: launch cadence, booster reusability, Starship progression, Starlink subscribers, Crew Dragon, market share, contracts, and corporate metrics. [e002:f04] Key Takeaways SpaceX recorded 165 orbital launches in 2025, up from 134 in 2024 and 25 in 2020, a sixfold increase in five years. [e002:f05] Starlink’s average revenue per subscriber fell 18% to $81 per month in 2025, down from approximately $99 per month in 2023, according to The Information. [e002:f06] SpaceX’s 2025 revenue is projected at around $15.5 billion (per Elon Musk) with about $8 billion in profit, according to Bloomberg and Reuters reporting, with Starlink driving 50-80% of sales. [e002:f07] Editor’s Choice 165 SpaceX launches in 2025, another annual record. evidence.title: SpaceX Falcon 9 launches Starlink satellites from West Coast
evidence.body: [e006:f01] Liftoff from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California occurred at 8:51 a.m. [e006:f02] The Falcon 9 look a southerly trajectory on departure from Space Launch Complex 4E, as it targeted an 97-degree inclination orbit. [e006:f03] The Falcon 9 first stage booster, launching for an eighth time, touched down on the droneship, ‘Of Course I Still Love You’, stationed about 380 miles downrange in the Pacific Ocean. [e006:f04] The booster, B1100, previously launched the NROL-105 mission for the US government spy satellite agency and six previous Starlink missions. [e006:f05] SpaceX confirmed a successful deployment of the 24 Starlink V2 Mini satellites from the Falcon 9 second stage into a 168 x 160-mile orbit just over an hour into the mission. [e006:f06] The Starlink 17-51 mission was the seventh of eight planned Falcon 9 launches this month from Vandenberg. [e006:f07] SpaceX’s West Coast pad has become the company’s workhorse launch facility in recent months as it focuses on Starship preparations in Florida. [e006:f08] By comparison, four Falcon 9 missions have flown from Space Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral in July so far and one more is planned. evidence.title: After SpaceX’s Launch, Investors Should Keep an Eye Out for These IPOs
evidence.body: [e003:f01] Less than a week after its record-setting IPO , the stock has gained 24%, making SpaceX — which includes satellite broadband provider Starlink, xAI and rocket launch services — the fifth largest publicly traded company on Earth and paving the way for a flurry of other companies to follow suit later this year. [e003:f02] The uptick comes after a notable decline in the number of IPOs over the past several years. [e003:f03] After a record 1,035 companies went public in 2021, just 181 held IPOs in 2022, marking a nearly 83% year-over-year decrease. [e003:f04] In 2023, that number fell to just 154 IPOs — the lowest since 2016. [e003:f05] But with 171 public listings so far this year, IPOs have taken center stage. [e003:f06] “Since the big pullback in 2022 and ’23, I think [a successful SpaceX IPO] could definitely open the door,” Jennifer Horton, executive vice president at CapWealth, previously told Money . [e003:f07] With data from prediction markets as well as the Nasdaq’s IPO calendar supporting that notion, the following four companies could hold public listings by the end of 2026 as they aim to replicate SpaceX’s successful launch. [e003:f08] OpenAI could be the next mega-cap company to IPO OpenAI, the company behind the large language model (LLM) ChatGPT, announced on June 8 that it had confidentially filed Form S-1 — the legal document required to pursue a public offering — with the U.S. [e003:f09] Like SpaceX, OpenAI is currently operating at a net loss that analysts expect to reach $14 billion by the end of 2026. [e003:f10] OpenAI is projected to reach profitability around 2029, but because the company is private and its S-1 hasn’t yet been made publicly available, prospective investors will have to wait to evaluate financial disclosures. [e003:f11] According to a press release , the LLM provider has not decided on the timing of its IPO . [e003:f12] The company, which develops LLMs and advanced AI assistants — the most popular of which are in the Claude family of models — filed its S-1 on June 1. [e003:f13] In a press release , Anthropic hedged against specific expectations, stating that the S-1 filing “gives us the option to go public after the SEC completes its review… [but] the proposed initial public offering will depend on market conditions and other factors.” However, the company is proceeding cautiously. [e003:f14] “The government has to do its part as well… but the onus primarily falls on us.” On May 28, Anthropic closed a funding round that raised $65 billion, bringing its valuation to $965 billion , or 13% higher than Sam Altman-led OpenAI. [e003:f15] Kraken paused its plans for an IPO due to the bear market despite confidentially filing its S-1 with the SEC in November 2025. evidence.title: SpaceX launches Starship in first test since record IPO
evidence.body: [e004:f01] The roughly 400-foot Starship rocket system lifted off from SpaceX’s Starbase facility in South Texas at about 6:50 p.m. [e004:f02] The mission marked the company’s latest attempt to demonstrate progress toward developing a fully reusable launch system capable of carrying people and cargo into space. [e004:f03] During the flight, the rocket deployed 20 upgraded Starlink V3 satellites into a suborbital trajectory. [e004:f04] The satellites briefly connected with SpaceX’s existing network of roughly 10,000 Starlink satellites before following the planned trajectory into Earth’s atmosphere and burning up. [e004:f05] READ: Google now owns 5% of SpaceX after historic IPO (July 23, 2026) The Starship’s Super Heavy booster separated from the upper-stage spacecraft roughly two minutes after liftoff. [e004:f06] The booster subsequently made a controlled splashdown in the Gulf of Mexico, while the Starship spacecraft continued toward its planned landing in the Indian Ocean. [e004:f07] An earlier launch attempt in July was aborted at the last moment after some of the rocket’s 33 engines failed to ignite, prompting SpaceX to postpone the flight. [e004:f08] Investors are closely watching the latest test following SpaceX’s record IPO. [e004:f09] The company went public last month in what has been described as the largest IPO in history, bringing increased market attention to its ambitious plans for Starship, Starlink and other businesses. [e004:f10] Starship is central to Musk’s long-term plans for space exploration, including missions to the Moon and Mars. [e004:f11] Full reusability remains one of SpaceX’s key objectives, as the company seeks to reduce the cost of launching payloads into orbit and increase launch frequency. [e004:f12] READ: SpaceX Starship launch aborted on pad at last second (July 17, 2026) The latest flight also demonstrated the potential role of Starship in SpaceX’s broader satellite business. [e004:f13] The test flight represents another step in SpaceX’s effort to turn Starship from an experimental vehicle into an operational launch system. [e004:f14] The company is seeking to move toward more frequent launches while improving the reliability and recovery of both the Super Heavy booster and Starship spacecraft. [e004:f15] For investors, the performance of Starship will remain closely tied to the company’s broader valuation and long-term growth expectations following its public listing. [e004:f16] The latest flight provided another high-profile test of SpaceX’s technology as the company begins its first phase of public-market scrutiny.

evidence.title: テスラのロボタクシー スペースXの「Starlink V5」搭載へ 統合への布石か
evidence.body: [e005:f01] テスラは7月20日、宇宙開発企業スペースX（SpaceX）の衛星通信サービスStarlink（スターリンク）の最新アンテナ「V5」をCybercabへ直接組み込むと、公式X（旧Twitter）で図解つきで発表した。 [e005:f02] 通信速度は375Mbps超とされる。 [e005:f03] ただしテスラは、この衛星通信が自動運転の走行そのものに使われるわけではないと説明する。 [e005:f04] 「なぜ自動運転タクシーに宇宙のインターネットが必要なのか」。 [e005:f05] 業界にそんな疑問が広がる一方、スペースXの新規株式公開を前にした、テスラとスペースXの統合への布石だとの見方も出ている。 [e005:f06] リースナブル （車のカーリース） お好きな車が月1万円台！ [e005:f07] パソナキャリア 転職後の平均年収837〜1,015万円 タクシーアプリDiDi クーポンが充実！ [e005:f08] リースナブル 新車が月々2万円から！ [e005:f09] 「乗車無料」チャンス ■Cybercabに載る「Starlink V5」 テスラは7月20日、公式Xで「Starlink V5 directly integrated in Cybercab」と題した図解を投稿し、自動運転タクシーCybercabにStarlinkの最新アンテナを直接組み込む方針を明らかにした。 [e005:f10] このStarlinkを手がけるのは、イーロン・マスク（Elon Musk）氏が率いるスペースXである。 [e005:f11] スペースX側も「自動運転車の未来へ、宇宙からの高速インターネットを」と呼応する投稿をした。 [e005:f12] 搭載されるのは最新世代のアンテナ「V5」だ。 [e005:f13] 従来のV4より大幅に小型で軽く、消費電力も抑えられている。 [e005:f14] ただし、この統合は現行の量産車にすでに搭載されているものではなく、より多くの通信量が必要になる将来に備えて確定させた設計だと説明されている。 [e005:f15] テスラの車が、単なる移動手段ではなく常時ネットにつながる端末へと近づく一歩と言える。 [e005:f16] テスラは車を移動手段ではなく、常時つながる端末として設計し始めている。

previous_updates.title: SpaceX、Vandenbergで2026年50回目の打ち上げ
previous_updates.summary: Vandenbergでは7月1日と10日にもFalcon 9によるStarlink打ち上げが行われ、7月21日の飛行がカリフォルニア州で2026年50回目の打ち上げとなった。 別のStarlinkミッションはエンジン点火後に直前中止となったが、SpaceXは機体とペイロードが安全だと説明した。 当初の離昇予定は米東部時間7時49分だった。

evidence.title: SpaceX launches Falcon 9 from Vandenberg Space Force Base
evidence.body: [e003:f01] A Falcon 9 carrying 24 Starlink satellites to low-Earth orbit lifted off Saturday morning from Space Launch Complex 4 East (SLC-4E). [e003:f02] UPDATE: Liftoff occurred shortly after 8:50 a.m.—ORIGINAL STORY: SpaceX is gearing up for an early weekend launch from Vandenberg Space Force Base.A Falcon 9 carrying 24 Starlink satellites to low-Earth orbit is set for liftoff at 7 a.m. [e003:f03] Saturday, the start of the four-hour launch window, from Space Launch Complex 4 East (SLC-4E).Following stage separation, the booster, which has been used 7 previous times, primarily on Starlink missions, is expected to land on a droneship in the Pacific Ocean. [e003:f04] No sonic boom is expected to be heard locally.A live webcast of the launch, which is expected to begin approximately 10 minutes before liftoff, will be up on and X @ launch will mark the 51st overall launch from Vandenberg so far this year.
